rules.rule:
Test conventions (see CLAUDE.md, Testing):
- Unit tests: Vitest + jsdom + `@vue/test-utils`. Reuse helpers from `src/tests/unit/helpers/` (`createAstroRender`, `createStoreMockImpl`, `createComponentStub`, `createSlotStub`) instead of re-implementing them.
- `createAstroRender` belongs in `beforeAll` with a 30 s timeout, unless the test calls `vi.resetModules()` per test.
- Do not `vi.mock` `virtual:icons/*` (auto-stubbed in `vitest.config.ts`). Prefer `config.global.stubs` for async components; hand-rolled Proxy `vi.mock` factories must include `[Symbol.toStringTag]: 'Module'` (use `createComponentStub`).
- Components stored in `ref()` or passed as reactive props need `markRaw()`.
- Flag tests that cannot fail (no assertion, asserting on the mock itself, snapshot-only for logic), missing cleanup of fake timers/mocks, and timing-dependent waits.
- E2E (`src/tests/e2e/`, Playwright): only navigate to slugs in `E2E_REQUIRED_SLUGS` (CI builds just 500 word pages); avoid fixed `waitForTimeout`, use web-first assertions.
- Path aliases instead of relative imports.

Project conventions (see CLAUDE.md):
- BEMIT class names only: `.c-` component, `.o-` object, `.u-` utility, `.is-`/`.has-` state; `.js-` hooks must never be styled. Pattern `.c-block__element--modifier`, hyphenated words. Flag plain BEM without namespace prefix.
- `@use "@styles/..."`, never `@import`.
- No raw `@media (width >= ...)`: viewport breakpoints go through `@include mx.breakpoint("sm")`; prefer a container query when the behavior depends on the component's own width.
- Raised cards use `mx.paper-card`; muted text `var(--color-muted)`; orange CTA `.c-button--primary`. Flag new box-shadows (one shadow, "Paper Lift", for all raised surfaces).
- Every color/surface change must also work in dark mode (`butler-mx.dark-mode-class`).
- Non-Baseline CSS only as progressive enhancement; content/function must not depend on it.

Project conventions (see CLAUDE.md):
- `<script setup lang="ts">` Composition API only; block order template → script → style.
- `<style lang="scss">` WITHOUT `scoped`; component styles live in `src/styles/components/_name.scss`, loaded via `@use` in the component's own style block. Class names follow BEMIT (`.c-`, `.o-`, `.u-`, `.is-`/`.has-`, `.js-`).
- Before custom browser-API/reactivity code (listeners, debounce, observers, storage, clipboard, keyboard, swipe, media queries), check whether `@vueuse/core` already provides it; flag hand-rolled equivalents.
- Icons: Lucide only, loaded via `defineAsyncComponent(() => import("virtual:icons/lucide/..."))`.
- Modals open via `open()` from `@stores/modal.ts` with `defineAsyncComponent`.
- Stores via `useStore()` from `@nanostores/vue`; import from the individual store file. Flag imports from `@stores/index` / `@stores` barrel unless `wordList.ts` exports are needed (its side effect fetches the search index).
- Interactions tracked with `trackEvent()` from `@utils/analytics`.
- Path aliases (`@components/`, `@stores/`, `@utils/`, ...), never relative `../` imports.
- Accessibility basics: interactive elements are buttons/links, labels present, no interactive elements inside `<summary>`.

Project conventions (see CLAUDE.md):
- `<script>` blocks run only once because of View Transitions (`ClientRouter`): DOM-querying logic must be wrapped in `document.addEventListener("astro:page-load", ...)`. Flag scripts that query the DOM at top level.
- Guard ResizeObserver/getBoundingClientRect callbacks against transitional zero heights (`if (h > 0)`).
- In `wort/[...wordSlug].astro`: never compute per-word similarity/anagram data in `getStaticPaths` (O(n²) over ~6000 words); derive it in the page body.
- Env vars come from `astro:env/client` / `astro:env/server`, never `import.meta.env` for schema vars.
- Path aliases instead of relative imports; no `@stores/index` barrel imports.

Project conventions (see CLAUDE.md):
- Path aliases (`@components/`, `@stores/`, `@utils/`, `@services/`, `@composables/`, `@lib/`, ...), never relative `../` imports.
- Nanostores: exports use `$` prefix; async computed stores use `computedAsync` from `@nanostores/async`, not the deprecated `computed()` + `task()` pattern. Flag imports from the `@stores/index` barrel unless `wordList.ts` exports are needed.
- Env vars via `astro:env/client` / `astro:env/server`.
- Imagor URL signing (`src/utils/imagor.ts`) and anything touching secrets (`IMAGOR_SECRET`, `PAYLOAD_SECRET`, `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY`) must stay server/build-side; flag any path that could ship them to the client.
- Native Baseline JS features, no polyfills; prefer VueUse over custom composables.
